summary.interpretation: On this constructed same-Lift handoff census, cooperation changes admission at every declared noninitial boundary while the executed source object and ten source/history values are preserved. The universal rooted graph certificates, not a failure observed on the bounded trace, reject retained/native candidates for cooperation.

validation.derivation: Exact auditor-authored anonymous summary, separately pinning the complete local detailed review.

scope: Static snapshot of completed saved-graph certificates and twenty executed Python handoff episodes; no relocated consumer qualification.
limits: All three single-button restrictions were statically inspected before selecting G !b3; selection is outcome-informed, not held out.
The old contract is constructed by adding G !b3 to the same Lift source. This is one model with ten old private nodes/eight source-history valuations, not ten independent applications.
The nonzero response monitors have their response predicates already true at the boundary and clear on the next update. No unserved pending request is carried past the boundary.
Every executed suffix is a fair lasso under the fixed lexicographic input policy, which never chooses b3=true. No measured failure avoidance or behavioral activation by b3=true is established.

Normalized extraction precedes the preference candidate in the frozen pool and is selected in all ten cooperative-policy episodes; preference is eligible but never installed. Necessity of the preference extractor is not supported.
Fresh targets use their actually stored rank-zero private nodes. Source/history continuity does not establish arbitrary transfer of old private controller memory.
The original 11 replacement, 14-pair negative, and 59-case diagnostic cohorts, and the v46 Elevator residual census remain separate and unchanged.
No new native/compiler execution occurred. Public delivery requires a separately audited static snapshot and must not claim the older replay entrypoint executes these new runs.
RSS bounds are sampled process checks, not an operating-system address-space cap; recorded elapsed time is not an end-to-end performance claim.
